name: elbv2
description: Elastic Load Balancing A load balancer distributes incoming traffic across targets, such as your EC2 instances.

subcommands.name: add-listener-certificates
subcommands.description: Adds the specified SSL server certificate to the certificate list for the specified HTTPS or TLS listener.

subcommands.name: add-tags
subcommands.description: Adds the specified tags to the specified Elastic Load Balancing resource.

subcommands.name: add-trust-store-revocations
subcommands.description: Adds the specified revocation file to the specified trust store.

subcommands.name: create-listener
subcommands.description: Creates a listener for the specified Application Load Balancer, Network Load Balancer, or Gateway Load Balancer.

subcommands.name: create-load-balancer
subcommands.description: Creates an Application Load Balancer, Network Load Balancer, or Gateway Load Balancer.

subcommands.name: create-rule
subcommands.description: Creates a rule for the specified listener.

subcommands.name: create-target-group
subcommands.description: Creates a target group.

subcommands.name: create-trust-store
subcommands.description: Creates a trust store.

subcommands.name: delete-listener
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified listener.

subcommands.name: delete-load-balancer
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified Application Load Balancer, Network Load Balancer, or Gateway Load Balancer.

subcommands.name: delete-rule
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified rule.

subcommands.name: delete-shared-trust-store-association
subcommands.description: Deletes a shared trust store association.

subcommands.name: delete-target-group
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified target group.

subcommands.name: delete-trust-store
subcommands.description: Deletes a trust store.

subcommands.name: deregister-targets
subcommands.description: Deregisters the specified targets from the specified target group.

subcommands.name: describe-account-limits
subcommands.description: Describes the current Elastic Load Balancing resource limits for your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: describe-capacity-reservation
subcommands.description: Describes the capacity reservation status for the specified load balancer.

subcommands.name: describe-listener-attributes
subcommands.description: Describes the attributes for the specified listener.

subcommands.name: describe-listener-certificates
subcommands.description: Describes the default certificate and the certificate list for the specified HTTPS or TLS listener.

subcommands.name: describe-listeners
subcommands.description: Describes the specified listeners or the listeners for the specified Application Load Balancer, Network Load Balancer, or Gateway Load Balancer.

subcommands.name: describe-load-balancer-attributes
subcommands.description: Describes the attributes for the specified Application Load Balancer, Network Load Balancer, or Gateway Load Balancer.

subcommands.name: describe-load-balancers
subcommands.description: Describes the specified load balancers or all of your load balancers.

subcommands.name: describe-rules
subcommands.description: Describes the specified rules or the rules for the specified listener.

subcommands.name: describe-ssl-policies
subcommands.description: Describes the specified policies or all policies used for SSL negotiation.

subcommands.name: describe-tags
subcommands.description: Describes the tags for the specified Elastic Load Balancing resources.

subcommands.name: describe-target-group-attributes
subcommands.description: Describes the attributes for the specified target group.

subcommands.name: describe-target-groups
subcommands.description: Describes the specified target groups or all of your target groups.

subcommands.name: describe-target-health
subcommands.description: Describes the health of the specified targets or all of your targets.

subcommands.name: describe-trust-store-associations
subcommands.description: Describes all resources associated with the specified trust store.

subcommands.name: describe-trust-store-revocations
subcommands.description: Describes the revocation files in use by the specified trust store or revocation files.

subcommands.name: describe-trust-stores
subcommands.description: Describes all trust stores for the specified account.

subcommands.name: get-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves the resource policy for a specified resource.

subcommands.name: get-trust-store-ca-certificates-bundle
subcommands.description: Retrieves the ca certificate bundle.

subcommands.name: get-trust-store-revocation-content
subcommands.description: Retrieves the specified revocation file.

subcommands.name: modify-capacity-reservation
subcommands.description: Modifies the capacity reservation of the specified load balancer.

subcommands.name: modify-ip-pools
subcommands.description: [Application Load Balancers] Modify the IP pool associated to a load balancer.

subcommands.name: modify-listener
subcommands.description: Replaces the specified properties of the specified listener.

subcommands.name: modify-listener-attributes
subcommands.description: Modifies the specified attributes of the specified listener.

subcommands.name: modify-load-balancer-attributes
subcommands.description: Modifies the specified attributes of the specified Application Load Balancer, Network Load Balancer, or Gateway Load Balancer.

subcommands.name: modify-rule
subcommands.description: Replaces the specified properties of the specified rule.

subcommands.name: modify-target-group
subcommands.description: Modifies the health checks used when evaluating the health state of the targets in the specified target group.

subcommands.name: modify-target-group-attributes
subcommands.description: Modifies the specified attributes of the specified target group.

subcommands.name: modify-trust-store
subcommands.description: Update the ca certificate bundle for the specified trust store.

subcommands.name: register-targets
subcommands.description: Registers the specified targets with the specified target group.

subcommands.name: remove-listener-certificates
subcommands.description: Removes the specified certificate from the certificate list for the specified HTTPS or TLS listener.

subcommands.name: remove-tags
subcommands.description: Removes the specified tags from the specified Elastic Load Balancing resources.

subcommands.name: remove-trust-store-revocations
subcommands.description: Removes the specified revocation file from the specified trust store.

subcommands.name: set-ip-address-type
subcommands.description: Sets the type of IP addresses used by the subnets of the specified load balancer.

subcommands.name: set-rule-priorities
subcommands.description: Sets the priorities of the specified rules.

subcommands.name: set-security-groups
subcommands.description: Associates the specified security groups with the specified Application Load Balancer or Network Load Balancer.

subcommands.name: set-subnets
subcommands.description: Enables the Availability Zones for the specified public subnets for the specified Application Load Balancer, Network Load Balancer or Gateway Load Balancer.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: load-balancer-available
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query LoadBalancers[].State.Code returns active for all elements when polling with ``describe-load-balancers``.

subcommands.name: load-balancer-exists
subcommands.description: Wait until 200 response is received when polling with ``describe-load-balancers``.

subcommands.name: load-balancers-deleted
subcommands.description: Wait until LoadBalancerNotFound is thrown when polling with ``describe-load-balancers``.

subcommands.name: target-deregistered
subcommands.description: Wait until InvalidTarget is thrown when polling with ``describe-target-health``.

subcommands.name: target-in-service
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query TargetHealthDescriptions[].TargetHealth.State returns healthy for all elements when polling with ``describe-target-health``.
